name: egm
description: Choose a restaurant with built-in web search and fresh Goldfish reviewers. No setup required.

interface.shortDescription: Choose dinner with no extra setup
interface.longDescription: Help undecided diners choose one restaurant and a backup using the host's built-in web search, then challenge the proposal with fresh, isolated reviewers. No Maps MCP connection, API key, or separate account is required; diners can share restaurant names or links if search is unavailable. Includes the upstream EGM workflows for design and document review. This comedic fork is independently maintained and is not an official Google product.
defaultPrompt: Help us pick a restaurant for tonight with one backup.
Audit this dining plan for hours, reviews, and parking risks.
Help me turn this software idea into a clear plan.
